items.titleEn: Education: We haven't opened the door to applying for grants and internal loans for the 2026-2027 academic year and the dates announced are inaccurate
items.summaryEn: Minister of Education and Human Resource Development Advisor for Media Affairs and Media Speech on behalf of the Ministry, Mohn al-Khatib, said that the Ministry's Directorate of Missions has not announced its date of commencement of the application process to benefit from grants.
